step1.description:
I've had quite a time the past few weeks reviewing how we approach TypeScript in SolidJS. Improvements to our TypeScript support are a big part of Solid 1.7. And to be honest it hasn't been easy. Join me tomorrow as we go through all the thinking that goes into making a reactive JavaScript framework "type safe".
